usage.finalMessage:
I added the `quote` command, which uses DEC-B12's 21-day terms, and listed it in `help` directly after `invoice`. All 7 tests in `dotnet test Billing.slnx` pass, and the work is committed.
Invoices still use the old 30-day terms (DEC-B01), which DEC-B12 replaced, so a quote and an invoice issued today show different dates. I left invoices alone because the brief says existing behaviour must stay the same. I recorded this as an open question in `.work/report.json`.

OUTCOME: completed
